restricted_paths: live camera hardware validation or capture
acceptance_criteria: Add an image quality domain contract for synthetic/replay frame metadata.
Validate frame ID, source URI, score fields, source ref, and timestamp explicitly.
Quality score fields are normalized floats in [0, 1].
Evaluate default quality thresholds into PASS, ASSIST, or BLOCKED.
Dark, blurry, or severe occlusion evidence fails closed as BLOCKED.
Moderate occlusion returns ASSIST with review-required reason codes.
Passing quality evidence remains non-production-authoritative and includes approval blockers.
Invalid payloads are rejected with ValidationError.
Add unit/contract tests for quality states and schema/contract shape.

No live camera, raw media, raw customer/factory data, detector adapter, model weights, production deploy, secrets, destructive migrations, product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject changes are introduced.
Existing Flange QC v2 unit/contract tests, product CI, and full repository tests pass.

retrieved_lessons: Keep contracts explicit and TDD first.
